version-id.description: Unique identifier — must match the version folder name (e.g. "1.0.0")

name.description: Human-readable name for this architecture version (e.g. release name)

description.description: Brief description of what this version represents — key changes, goals, or scope relative to previous versions

status.description: Lifecycle status — draft (in progress), published (baseline), archived (superseded)

release-date.description: Date this version was published (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-06-01). Leave blank for draft versions.
